task: Independent Rama R3 runtime-imported eyelid blink visual review
reviewer: independent eyelid_review agent; no asset, runtime, import, or renderer changes
summary: R3 repairs the rejected R2 black outer skin-patch outlines and exposed closed-eye globe. Neutral eyes remain aligned and closed skin hides the visible eye in all three views. The closed eyelid still reads as a narrow raised horizontal strip with conspicuous parallel boundaries and bright corner joins, especially three-quarter/profile, so the requested finished eyelid quality is not passed.

inclusive_sequential_range_actually_view: /workspace/scratch/rama-face-render-r3/blink-000.png through blink-029.png, all 30 frames opened individually at original resolution

findings.observation: Pupils/irises keep consistent placement and do not visibly diverge from the matched baseline. No floating eye is apparent in these images.
At full closure no visible iris, pupil, or white globe remains. Skin fills the opening; the eye does not remain exposed as in rejected R2 front-closed.png.
The large discontinuous black polygonal ring surrounding each eye in rejected R2 front-open/front-closed is absent from R3.

findings.criterion: Closed lid shape and corner integration
findings.observation: The closure has a broad narrow skin strip between two dark, nearly horizontal lines rather than a softly integrated curved meeting edge. Its raised shelf/bulge reads most clearly at the near eye in three-quarter/profile. Pale angular joins remain at the inner corners and lower rim. These are much smaller than the R2 outline defect but remain visible at this face-close-up scale.

Both eyes progress together from open to closed and return open without visible asymmetric pop, detached patch, black boundary flash, or isolated broken frame. Closing is fast across 003-005 and reopening across 009-012; it remains a coherent ordered progression. Frames 014-029 hold the neutral appearance.

gate_scope.Q1_eyelid_subset: LIMITED: eye occlusion/alignment repaired; closed lid strip and corner integration remain visible
gate_scope.Q1_full_hair_face_costume: OPEN: this review covers face-close-up eyelids only, not complete required views or gameplay camera
gate_scope.Q2_blink_sequential_visual_subset: PASS for the supplied 30 front-view frames only; broader secondary-motion/contact gate unreviewed
gate_scope.Q5_time_and_lifecycle: UNRUN by this reviewer; no independent 30/60/120 Hz, pause/reset/death, or 100-cycle tests executed
gate_scope.physical_gpu_or_hardware_fps: UNRUN; captured with llvmpipe; fixed 60 Hz sample metadata establishes no hardware pacing
gate_scope.AAA_or_full_facial_animation_or_gameplay: OPEN/unreviewed; no gaze, jaw, brow, full facial performance, or actual gameplay claim

remaining_action: Face owner should soften the raised closure strip and corner joins if seeking an unconditional bounded eyelid appearance pass. Root/QA retain broader Q1/Q2/Q5 and production gates.
